# Now Hear This

> Award-winning audiology clinic in Raleigh, NC specializing in hearing aids, Real Ear Measurements, and personalized hearing care from leading manufacturers.

Now Hear This is a premier audiology practice in Raleigh offering comprehensive hearing health services including fitting and programming of premium hearing aids from brands like Phonak, Oticon, Starkey, Signia, Widex, ReSound, and Unitron. The clinic is known for utilizing Real Ear Measurements (REM) technology for precise hearing aid fitting and maintains strong patient testimonials and media recognition.

- Real Ear Measurements (REM)
